target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one vCPU, native compiler
observed: 0x29 (41): the nested directive incremented the value before the preceding if assignment overwrote it
basis: Pinned ParseIf calls ParseStatement with its default semicolon processing, which calls Lex to look for else. Lex dispatches KW_EXE to ParseStreamBlk before LexStatement2Bin returns to ExeCmdLine to execute the if.
status: QEMU passes source-inferred behavior; upstream x86 runtime comparison outstanding
limits: This case checks execution order of a nested directive after an if; it does not establish behavior for already-expanded macro redefinition or other control-flow forms. Prior characterization as a confirmed bug was incorrect.
